title: Descent of the strict tensor limit model
statement: For a scheme isomorphism and normalized completion and tensor data, assume the strict good-complex model equation and its two-variable naturality. Then the corresponding normalized tensor limit equation holds on every pair of complete constructible objects.

source.place: Steps 2 and 4, descent from good-complex representatives through the product localization; Stacks 08TC and 0941.

proof.text: Choose simultaneous good-complex representatives of the two constructible inputs and transport the strict model equation through the two normalized tensor realization isomorphisms. The strict equation is the Model hypothesis, while the Roos and tensor comparison components are the displayed frame maps.

Use Naturality to make the transported equation independent of representatives. Fully faithful whiskering by the product of the good-complex localizations then descends it to arbitrary complete constructible M and N, yielding the frame equation.

proof_origin.place: Steps 2 and 4, strict model transport and localization descent.

theorem podReindexing_tensor_limit_model_descent
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (A : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g A)
    (hA : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g A)
    (_hModel : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Model l E g A T)
    (_hNaturality : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Naturality l E g A T)
    (M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) :
    let q := podReindexingTensorFrame l E g A hA M.obj N.obj
    let t : q.F.obj q.CY ⟶ q.CX := (T.tensor M N).hom
    q.F.map q.dY.hom ≫ q.δ.app q.U ≫ q.RX.map (q.w₁ ≫ q.w₂) =
      t ≫ q.dX.hom
